title: Why Were US Flights Suddenly Grounded?

retention_map.0-3s: INSTANT HOOK: every US departure told to stop, the board flips to GROUNDED
retention_map.3-10s: FIRST SURPRISE: radar and radio glitch at 3:36 PM, the big red GROUND STOP button 18 minutes later
retention_map.10-18s: ESCALATION: why stopping is the safe move; planes already flying keep going
retention_map.18-27s: NEW MYSTERY: the suspect is a router in Arkansas flooding the network with data
retention_map.27-38s: BIG REVEAL: more than four hours, more than 7,000 cancellations in one day
retention_map.38-50s: COMEDY PAYOFF + MONEY ANGLE: 12.5 billion approved vs 50 billion requested
retention_map.50-60s: CONCLUSION + FINAL JOKE (refund, not credit; keep the pretzels), then the standard end card (automatic)

scenes.title: Everything Stops
scenes.retention_hook: Instant hook: the departures board flips to GROUNDED, one row at a time

dialogue.text: On November thirteenth, the FAA told US airlines: nobody takes off.

actions: Departures board rows flip from ON TIME to GROUNDED one by one
Everyday Guy with a suitcase looks up at the board
He drops the suitcase

scenes.title: The Big Red Button
scenes.retention_hook: First surprise: glitching radar at 3:36 PM, then the FAA hits the red button 18 minutes later

dialogue.text: At three thirty-six PM, radar and radio glitched. Eighteen minutes later: ground stop.

actions: Radar screen glitches: SIGNAL LOST
Friend (air traffic controller) panics
FAA Banker slams the red GROUND STOP button
GROUND STOP stamp

scenes.title: Why Stop Everything?
scenes.retention_hook: Escalation: stopping is the safe move; planes already flying keep going

dialogue.text: Why stop? If radar and radio get fuzzy, the safest move is: nobody new takes off. Planes already flying keep going.

actions: Two planes wait on the runway under STOP signs
A third plane keeps flying across the sky

scenes.title: The Suspect: A Router
scenes.retention_hook: New mystery: a router in Arkansas flooded the network with data; no cyberattack found

dialogue.text: The suspect: a router in Arkansas flooding the network with data. No sign of a cyberattack, and investigators are still checking why.

actions: A worried router box spews data packets
Screens fill with errors
Friend panics: too much data
Green check: no evidence of a cyberattack

scenes.title: The Domino Effect
scenes.retention_hook: Big reveal: over four hours, then more than 7,000 cancellations in one day

dialogue.text: It lasted over four hours, and more than seven thousand flights were cancelled that Friday.

actions: Clock shows 4+ HOURS
Counter climbs to 7,000+ cancelled flights
Guy naps on his suitcase: 'I live here now'

scenes.title: The Money Angle
scenes.retention_hook: Comedy payoff + money angle: 12.5 billion approved vs 50 billion requested

dialogue.text: Congress approved twelve and a half billion dollars for upgrades. The Transportation Secretary wants fifty billion.

actions: Two bars: 12.5B approved vs 50B requested
Banker opens his wallet: one coin falls out

scenes.title: Conclusion: Know Your Refund
scenes.retention_hook: Conclusion + final joke: refund, not credit; keep the pretzels

dialogue.text: Officials say equipment, not an attack. And if your flight is cancelled, you are owed a refund, not just a credit.

actions: Agent offers a travel credit voucher
Guy holds up a REFUND sign
Agent swaps the voucher for money
Final joke: Guy asks to keep the pretzels
scenes.note: Sources: NBC News, ABC News, CNN, KATV
